current_evidence: Three tries at westoxon.gov.uk /media/ PDFs (the workbook link, the householder 20-07-26 checklist and the older full-planning checklist) all returned client_error. The fetched supporting-information page showed no download links or dates. Site search also turned up older type-specific checklists (householder July 2024, LBC July 2024, outline, major validation criteria, LDC), so it could not be confirmed which file the page links to now. The 20-07-26 filename suggests the workbook link is the newest version.

issues.detail: The List date (2026-07-01) comes from PDF CreationDate metadata, not from the document text. The filename suffix '20-07-26' suggests the version is dated 20 July 2026. The date shown in the text could not be checked because the PDF would not fetch.

WODC has no single local list. It publishes a separate validation checklist for each application type. The workbook link is only the Full planning checklist, but it is used as the 'Validation list URL' for every application type. Checklists that exist for Outline, Listed building consent, Discharge of conditions and Advertisement consent were not used as sources for those rows.
issues.evidence: Site search results: 'Outline planning permission: some matters reserved Validation Checklist', 'wodc-listed-building-consent-validation-checklist-july-2024.pdf', 'Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge) Validation Checklist'; Grokbot tab text: 'Consent To Display An Advertisement WODC - pdf'

issues.detail: Every 'Listed building consent' row (BNG, block plan, CIL form, site levels, elevations, planning statement, roof plan, self-build) is sourced from the Removal or Variation of a Condition (s73) checklist, not from a listed building consent checklist. These rows are copies of the s73 rows. WODC publishes a separate LBC checklist.
issues.evidence: LBC rows cite source 'removal-or-variation-of-a-condition-validation-checklist-wodc-20-07-26-af.pdf'; Grokbot tab text: 'Listed Building Consent Form WODC - pdf - 386 Kb'

issues.detail: Old and new checklist versions are mixed together. The Lawful development cert rows come from 2022/2023 checklists ('...existing-use-wodc-7-11-2022.pdf', '...proposed-use-wodc-24-05-23.pdf'). Several Submission rules items cite the superseded 2022 NMA checklist, although the 2026 NMA checklist ('...non-material-amendment-validation-checklist-wodc-final-20-07-26-af.pdf') was also read. The 2022 s73 checklist is also in docs_read.
issues.evidence: docs_read lists both 'non-material-amendment-validation-checklist-wodc-7-11-2022.pdf' and '...-final-20-07-26-af.pdf', and both 'removal-or-variation...-25-11-2022.pdf' and '...-20-07-26-af.pdf'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only'. But Grokbot's own extraction of the householder checklist (oyagfnem...20-07-26) contains local items such as Sustainability Statement and Tree Survey/Arboricultural Impact Assessment, and the council's 2023 checklists require the biodiversity self-assessment for all applications. Those householder items were instead filed under Full planning as 'INFERRED'. Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement consent and Discharge of conditions are also marked '(none)', although each has its own WODC checklist.
issues.evidence: Full planning row 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment' and 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' both cite householder-planning-permission-wodc-20-07-26-af.pdf; WODC notice 22 Dec 2022: 'A self-assessment form for all applications'

issues.detail: Nearly all Full planning rows (about 18) are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. That is the wrong basis, because the workbook URL is itself the Full planning checklist. Some of those rows were not taken from it: Arboricultural, Energy/Sustainability, Site levels, CIL and Schedule of works come from the householder checklist, and Cycle parking, Waste and Water efficiency come from the Sustainability Standards guidance page.
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning'

issues.detail: Biodiversity Self-Assessment Form is missing as a requirement row. It is a WODC local requirement for all applications and appears only in boilerplate Submission rules text.
issues.evidence: WODC notice 22 Dec 2022: 'Biodiversity - A self-assessment form for all applications'; Grokbot tab text: 'Our biodiversity requirement asks an applicant to submit a self-assessment form'

issues.detail: Two WODC local requirements are not captured. One is the Health Impact Assessment, which is required at minimum for major applications. The other is the ecologist's Declaration of Adequacy, which must accompany each ecological survey report.
issues.evidence: WODC notice 22 Dec 2022: 'Healthy place shaping: Major applications must provide, at a minimum, a Health Impact Assessment'; 'a Declaration of Adequacy from the specialist ecologist for each survey report'
issues.grok_comment: The Health Impact Assessment is missing: the checklist says "Health Impact Assessment ... All major applications" and the workbook has no HIA row. The ecologist "Declaration of Adequacy" does not appear in any WODC source document downloaded; Claude cites a 2022 notice that is not in raw/.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The Health Impact Assessment stands. The ecologist Declaration of Adequacy is unconfirmed in the current list, so it is dropped.

issues.detail: The Sustainability Statement / Sustainability Standards Checklist is a required document for full and minor/householder applications (template for minors, own report for majors). It is captured only as a Full planning row whose trigger is a list of document names, with no rule for when it applies.
issues.evidence: Planning page: full planning applications 'must submit a sustainable construction statement'; Grokbot tab: 'For major applications use your own report template For minor applications (including householder) use the report template below'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled, cut off or run together from neighbouring rows. Retail Impact Assessment reads 'Desirable for a variation of an existing legal agreement' (bled from another row). Heritage Statement is the fragment 'to the Heritage Statement requirement.' Planning Statement reads 'countryside Supporting Planning Statement'. Site levels (LBC/s73) runs into CIL charging text. CIL rows include 'All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format...'. Arboricultural and Energy rows are just lists of document names. None of these states when the requirement applies.
issues.evidence: Retail row trigger: 'Retail Impact Assessment What information is required? Desirable for a variation of an existing legal agreement.'

issues.detail: The 'Schedule of works (listed building)' trigger is about a Tree Protection Plan / Arboricultural Method Statement and pre-app requests, so it has nothing to do with a schedule of works. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' is mapped to Site Waste Management Plan guidance from the sustainability checklist rather than a refuse-storage requirement.
issues.evidence: Schedule of works trigger: '- Tree Protection Plan Arboricultural Method Statement Any other plans...'

issues.detail: Fire Statement is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. In the Full planning checklist it is a planning-application requirement for relevant buildings (Article 9A). The trigger is cut off mid-sentence and joined to Design and Access Statement text.
issues.evidence: Trigger: '...the material change of use would result in Explanation of the design principles and concepts...'

issues.detail: Most 'Submission rules' tab items are not requirements. They include download link text with file sizes ('WODC Householder Planning Permission Validation Checklist - pdf - 367 Kb'), page navigation prose, GDPR text ('We will only use your personal information...'), and the page footer 'All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format...' repeated about 10 times with page numbers and fragments. One item is an expired AWS-signed URL fragment for the 'Oxfordshire Innovation Framework'.
issues.evidence: tab_items Submission rules: 'All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format, ideally as PDF documents and not in draft format. 6'

issues.detail: Three LBC/s73 rows are not requirements. 'Self-build / custom build information' (trigger 'CIL e.g. self-build.') is a note about CIL exemptions. The LDC row 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is part of the site plan's content description. Cycle parking and Water efficiency rows are design guidance text from the Sustainability Standards Checklist.

Two drawing standards items are near-identical ('All drawings must include a title, drawing number, confirmation of the scale, and a scale bar' from two PDFs). A third repeats the same text after 'Trees and hedges within the application site...'.

summary: The workbook link and the other WODC checklist PDFs were blocked to fetch, so neither currency nor contents could be checked against the source. Grokbot's data has serious internal problems: LBC rows are copied from the s73 checklist, Householder is marked as having no local requirements, the biodiversity self-assessment and HIA are missing, and garbled triggers and boilerplate fill much of the tab.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
